title: Dating the Sphinx by its vernal equinox alignment with Leo
summary: Randall Carlson tells of Dating the Sphinx by its vernal equinox alignment with Leo, about 10,500 BC at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, I think didn't BVAL and and Hancock do sort of a dating based upon the fact of when the vernal equinox sunrise would have been when the Sphinx would have been looking directly at that.
